Headline target: Altor Fund Manager AB commits to reach net-zero GHG emissions from its in-scope financial activities by 2050. To reach this target, it has set different sub-targets:
Altor Fund Manager AB’s near-term portfolio targets cover 72% of its financial exposure to asset manager investing activities by invested capital* as of 2025. As of that year, required in-scope activities** made up 72% of Altor Fund Manager AB’s financial exposure to asset manager investing activities, while optional in-scope activities made up 28%. 
Altor Fund Manager AB’s long-term portfolio targets cover 100% of its financial exposure to asset manager investing activities by invested capital as of 2025. As of that year, in-scope activities made up 100% of Altor Fund Manager AB’s financial exposure to asset manager investing activities.  

*Invested capital only includes investments, and not cash on hand or undrawn commitments.
**These targets and coverage % do not include private equity investments made 24-months prior to the base year. 

https://files.sciencebasedtargets.org/production/files/FINZ-Validation-Statement_Altor-Fund-Manager-AB.pdf?dm=1789163930

Near-Term Targets
Non-portfolio Targets: Altor Fund Manager AB commits to maintain zero absolute scope 1 GHG emissions from 2021 base year through 2030. Altor Fund Manager AB commits to increase active annual sourcing of renewable electricity from 10% in 2021 to 100% by 2025 and to continue active sourcing of 100% renewable electricity through 2030.​.

Scope 3 Commitments and Policies
Deforestation Exposure: Altor Fund Manager AB commits to assess, monitor, and publicly disclose their deforestation exposure across in-scope financial activities, and publish an engagement plan should exposure be significant by 2030.
Fossil Fuel Transition Policy: i. Altor Fund Manager AB does not and will not engage in any applicable financial activities in the fossil fuel sector throughout the SBTi near-term target time frame. This covers applicable financial activities: (i) in the coal sector, (ii) related to oil and gas projects and new liquified natural gas infrastructure, and (iii) related to oil and gas companies.
ii. Altor Fund Manager AB defines coal, oil, and gas projects, companies, and value chain in line with SBTi Financial Institutions Net-Zero Standard’s definitions.

Scope 3 Portfolio Targets
Asset Manager Investing: Altor Fund Manager AB commits that 100% of its covered asset manager investing activities will be climate-aligned by 2030 from a 2025 base year. This includes:
100% climate-alignment of financial activities in segments B and C.
The financial institution uses the following methodologies to assess climate alignment: SBTi Target Status and EU Taxonomy.

Long-Term Targets
Non-Portfolio Targets: Altor Fund Manager AB commits to maintain zero absolute scope 1 GHG emissions from a 2021 base year through 2050. Altor Fund Manager AB commits to continue active annual sourcing of 100% renewable electricity from 2025 through 2050.

Scope 3 Portfolio Target: Altor Fund Manager AB commits that 100% of its applicable asset manager activities will have reached a net-zero state by 2050.

Generation Investment Management’s near-term portfolio targets cover 66% of its financial exposure to asset manager investing activities by invested capital* as of 2024. As of that year, required in-scope activities made up 66% of Generation Investment Management’s financial exposure to asset manager investing activities, while optional in-scope activities made up 9% and out-of-scope activities made up 25%. Generation Investment Management’s long-term portfolio targets cover 75% of its financial exposure to asset manager investing activities as of 2024. As of that year, in-scope activities made up 75% of Generation Investment Management’s financial exposure to asset manager investing and out-of-scope activities made up 25%.  
*Invested capital only includes investments, and not cash on hand or undrawn commitments.

https://files.sciencebasedtargets.org/production/files/FINZ-Validation-Statement_Generation-Investment-Management.pdf?dm=1793893757

Near-Term Targets
Non-portfolio Targets: Generation Investment Management has a target to reduce absolute scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions 42% by 2030 from a 2024 base year. Generation Investment Management has set a target that 33% of its suppliers by spend covering purchased goods and services and capital goods, will have science-based targets by 2030. Generation Investment Management has a target to reduce scope 3 GHG emissions from business travel and employee commuting 51.6% per full-time employee by 2030 from a 2024 base year.

Scope 3 Commitments and Policies
Deforestation Exposure: Generation Investment Management has set a target to assess, monitor, and publicly disclose their deforestation exposure across in-scope financial activities, and publish an engagement plan should exposure be significant.
Fossil Fuel Transition Policy: i. Generation Investment Management does not and will not engage in any applicable financial activities in the fossil fuel sector throughout the SBTi near-term target time frame. This covers applicable financial activities: (i) in the coal sector, (ii) related to oil and gas projects and new liquified natural gas infrastructure, and (iii) related to oil and gas companies.
ii. Generation Investment Management defines coal, oil, and gas projects, companies, and value chain in line with SBTi Financial Institutions Net-Zero Standard’s definitions.

Scope 3 Portfolio Targets
Asset Manager Investing: Generation Investment Management has set a target that 75% of its covered asset manager investing activities will be climate-aligned* by 2030 from a 2024 base year. This includes: 70% climate-alignment of financial activities in the Segment B; 75% climate-alignment of financial activities in the Segment C. *The financial institution uses the following methodologies to assess climate alignment: SBTi Target Status, MSCI Implied Temperature Rise, Transition Pathway Initiative (TPI) Methodology for Management Quality and Carbon Performance, MSCI NZIF Assessment, and EU Taxonomy.

Long-Term Targets
Non-Portfolio Targets: Generation Investment Management has a target to reduce absolute scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions 90% by 2040 from a 2024 base year. Generation Investment Management has set a target to reduce scope 3 GHG emissions from business travel and employee commuting 97% per full-time employee by 2040 from a 2024 base year. Generation Investment Management set a target to reduce scope 3 GHG emissions from purchased goods and services and capital goods 97% per full-time employee by 2040 from a 2024 base year.
Scope 3 Portfolio Target: Generation Investment Management has set a target that 95% of its applicable asset manager investing activities will have reached a net-zero state by 2040.

Overall Net-zero Target: Italmobiliare commits to reach net-zero GHG emissions across the value chain by 2050 from a 2023 base year.

Headline target: Italmobiliare commits to reach net-zero GHG emissions from its in-scope financial activities by 2050. To reach this target, it has set different sub-targets: 

- Italmobiliare’s near-term portfolio targets cover 35% exposure to asset owner investing activities and 83% exposure to asset manager investing activities by asset value as of 2023. As of that year, required in-scope activities made up 35% of Italmobiliare’s financial exposure to asset owner investing and 83% financial exposure to asset manager investing, while optional in-scope activities made up 7% and 11%, respectively, and out-of-scope activities made up 58% and 6%, respectively.

- Italmobiliare’s long-term portfolio targets cover 42% of its financial exposure to asset owner investing activities, 94% exposure to asset manager investing activities by asset value as of  2023. As of that year, in-scope activities made up 42% of Italmobiliare’s financial exposure to asset owner investing activities, 94% exposure to asset manager investing activities, while out-of- scope activities made up 58% and 6% respectively.

https://files.sciencebasedtargets.org/production/files/FINZ-Validation-Statement_Italmobiliare.pdf?dm=1789766459

Near-Term Targets
Non-portfolio Targets: Italmobiliare commits to reduce absolute scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions 42% by 2030 from a 2023 base year. Italmobiliare commits to continue active annual sourcing of 100% renewable electricity from 2023 to 2030. Italmobiliare commits that 50% of its suppliers by spend covering purchased goods and services, capital
goods, and upstream transportation and distribution will have science-based targets by 2028.

Scope 3 Commitments and Policies
Deforestation Exposure: Italmobiliare commits to assess, monitor, and publicly disclose their deforestation exposure across in-scope financial activities, and publish an engagement plan should exposure be significant by 2027.
Fossil Fuel Transition Policy: i. As of 2025, Italmobiliare does not and will not engage in any applicable financial activities in the fossil fuel sector throughout the SBTi near-term target time frame. This covers applicable financial activities: (i) in the coal sector, (ii) related to oil and gas projects and new liquified natural gas infrastructure, and (iii) related to oil and gas companies.
ii. Italmobiliare defines coal, oil, and gas projects, companies, and value chain in line with SBTi Financial Institutions Net-Zero Standard’s definitions.

Scope 3 Portfolio Targets
Asset Owner Investing: Italmobiliare commits that 100% of its covered asset owner investing activities will be climate-aligned by 2030 from a 2023 base year. This includes 100% climate-alignment of financial activities in segments B and C.

The financial institution uses the following methodologies to assess climate alignment: SBTi Target Status and EU Taxonomy.
Asset Manager Investing: Italmobiliare commits that 100% of its covered asset manager investing activities will be climate-aligned by 2030 from a 2023 base year. This includes 100% climate-alignment of financial activities in segment  B and C.

The financial institution uses the following methodologies to assess climate alignment: SBTi Target Status and EU Taxonomy.

Long-Term Targets
Non-Portfolio Targets: Italmobiliare commits to reduce absolute scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions 90% by 2050 from a 2023 base year. IItalmobiliare commits to continue active annual sourcing of 100% renewable electricity from 2023 to 2050. Italmobiliare commits to reduce absolute scope 3 GHG emissions 90% by 2050 from a 2023 base year.

Scope 3 Portfolio Target: Italmobiliare commits that 100% of its applicable asset owner investing and 100% of asset manager investing activities will have reached a net-zero state by 2050.

Overall Net-zero Target: Stirling Square commits to reach net-zero GHG emissions across the value chain by 2050 from a 2024 base year.

Headline target: Stirling Square commits to reach net-zero GHG emissions from its in-scope financial activities by 2050. To reach this target, it has set different sub-targets:
- Stirling Square’s near-term portfolio targets cover 100% of its financial exposure to asset manager investing. As of that year, required in-scope activities made up 100% of Stirling Square’s financial exposure to asset manager investing.
- Stirling Square’s alignment targets cover 100% of its in-scope asset manager investing activities by invested capital*.
- Stirling Square’s  long-term portfolio targets cover 100% of its financial exposure to asset manager investing. As of that year, in-scope activities made up 100% of Stirling Square’s financial exposure to asset manager investing.
*Invested capital only includes investments, and not cash on hand or undrawn commitments.

https://files.sciencebasedtargets.org/production/files/FINZ-Validation-Statement_Stirling-Square.pdf?dm=1779986192

Near-Term Targets
Non-portfolio Targets: Stirling Square commits to maintain zero absolute scope 1 GHG emissions from 2024 through 2031. Stirling Square commits to continue active annual sourcing of 100% renewable electricity from 2024 to 2031.

Scope 3 Commitments and Policies
Deforestation Exposure: Stirling Square commits to assess, monitor, and publicly disclose its deforestation exposure across in-scope financial activities, and publish an engagement plan should exposure be significant by 2030.
Fossil Fuel Transition Policy: Stirling Square does not and will not engage in any applicable financial activities in the fossil fuel sector throughout the SBTi near-term target time frame. This covers applicable financial activities: (i) in the coal sector, (ii) related to oil and gas projects and new liquified natural gas infrastructure, and (iii) related to oil and gas companies.
ii. Stirling Square defines coal, oil, and gas projects, companies, and value chain in line with SBTi Financial Institutions Net-Zero Standard’s definitions.

Scope 3 Portfolio Targets
Asset Manager Investing: Stirling Square commits that 42% of its applicable asset manager investing activities will be climate-aligned* by 2031 from a 2024 base year. This includes:
- 42% climate-alignment of financial activities in segment B and C.
*The financial institution uses the following methodologies to assess climate alignment: SBTi Target Status and EU Taxonomy.

Long-Term Targets
Non-Portfolio Targets: Stirling Square commits to maintain zero absolute scope 1 GHG emissions from 2024 through 2050. Stirling Square commits to continue active annual sourcing of 100% renewable electricity from 2024 to 2050.

Scope 3 Portfolio Target: Stirling Square commits that 100% of its applicable asset manager investing activities will have reached a net-zero state by 2050.
